title: Import catalog mask resources and show each adjustment’s source
source: rapidroom (original bounded mask encoding; existing catalog importer attribution retained)
notes: Catalog develop rows preserve ordered mask resources and every inline brush position through the existing image-aware XMP converter. Supported gradients, radial masks and brush strokes import from the catalog even when an XMP sidecar differs. The preview identifies catalog, history and orientation sources per value; existing RapidRoom edits still require explicit replacement. AI masks without recoverable pixels, unsupported resources and radius/flow changes within brush strokes are reported. Lightroom imports remain uncalibrated until full import calibration is complete.
